purpose: Research the effect of per-position nominal exposure on the development-selected, original unsplit 12H cloud-close account. This is not an execution instruction.

selection.fallback: The parent reward study falls back to tp_r=0 (original V1.7 cloud runner); admission falls back to rule=all. No later-period tuning.
selection.controls: Exclude is_control rows; admission rule is the parent study's fixed development pick.

account.allocation: Use the shared account and reward wallet's prepare/admit logic: fixed crc32(symbol), symbol, event_id priority; one position per symbol; occupied slot release only after the exit bar; no rebalancing. At entry cap each slot by min(NAV/12, free_cash/currently_flat_slots), then apply the exposure multiple to notional.
account.marking: Hourly OHLC, three stages per hour, using the source wallet's causal marks and gap convention. Hold a positive collateral share for either direction: price = 1 + max(1, exposure) * side * (spot / entry_spot - 1). Transform high/low in side-aware sorted order. For exposure below 1, position size is proportionally reduced and margin leverage remains 1x.
account.margin: Isolated collateral is fully reserved per position. For exposure >=1, initial margin is at most one twelfth of current NAV; for exposure <1, notional is proportionally smaller and fully collateralized. Entry fees are included in position sizing.
account.maintenance_policy: Vectorized boundary audit only. If any admitted position reaches the fee-inclusive isolated maintenance threshold under the scenario, mark that entire exposure/scenario invalid and report breach count and worst normalized equity shortfall. Do not synthesize liquidation fills or assume no liquidation. Same-hour threshold/strategy-exit ambiguity resolves conservatively as a breach.
account.unquoted_hours: Use the wallet prepare module's prior-observed-close carry convention and disclose unquoted position-hours; the missing intrahour path is not verified.

costs.funding: Not modeled; report as a limitation.
costs.capacity_and_lot_rounding: Not modeled; report as a limitation.

one_x_baseline.source_artifact: reward funded_tp{tp_r}.csv.gz / hourly_tp{tp_r}.csv.gz when admission pick is all; otherwise admission funded_{rule}.csv.gz / hourly_{rule}.csv.gz
